notes.title: Version 1.4.1 - Bugfix and feature update
notes.content:
This will be the last feature update to Prompt.  Controller support has been reworked to improve responsiveness and remove potentially dropped button inputs.  The brightness slider now works better on screens with low gamma.  There are in-game prompts indicating progression.  And most importantly, Prompt now crashes less and runs significantly better on certain Linux installs and displays at very high resolutions.

There have been many smaller tweaks besides the listed major changes - as always, feel free to let me know what you think in the forum.
